name: Crushing Rush (Combat)
body:
You can grind your foes underfoot.

Prerequisite: Greater Bull Rush, Greater Overrun, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Overrun, Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: If you successfully bull rush an opponent, you can immediately try to enter that foe’s square and attempt to overrun him (provided you have sufficient movement available).
